resources.string: Save foods from a diary date
Delete this reusable meal? Previously logged foods will remain unchanged.
No saved meals yet. Save selected foods from a diary date to reuse their portions.

Saved meals reuse the listed portions and nutrition snapshots. Missing nutrients remain unavailable or partial. This does not verify source nutrition. After logging, you can adjust individual foods in the diary.
Saved meal logged. Return to Food Log to view it.
A log is awaiting confirmation. Retry it before starting another. The same request will not be logged twice.
Saved meal operation failed. Check your connection and Firestore rules, then retry. %1$s
This stops retrying; it does not remove foods already saved. If the result was uncertain, check the destination diary before logging this meal again.
